message.text: Module inbox is built and merged. Any agent can now drop the essence of an owner ask on a module with the `module_inbox` tool; it lands in `<module>/inbox.jsonl` with the prompt linked. `node Server/ModuleReview.mjs --plan` lists modules with unread lines, the depth and model it would pick, and a token estimate. Tested on ux/Dictate with three real essences: plan says deep, Sonnet, 12 readmes/docs, about 21k tokens. Design page: /Servex/doc/module-inbox.md (linked from the Servex and ai readmes). Not built yet: spawning the per-module reviewers (next slice). The tool goes live at the next Servex restart.
